title: Cabin Systems — Second Generation Head End Chassis and Uprating of the Rack Feeder
abstract: Installation of the second generation head end chassis with the rack feeder uprating that its continuous load requires, replacing both the original and the interim server standards in one visit.

sections.planning_reason: The interim server standard restored reliability but left the cabin on an architecture that cannot carry wireless content delivery, and operators refitting their cabins were being asked to buy an entertainment system two generations behind what they sell. Three operators also reported that the rack feeder ran close to its continuous rating at full cabin load, which blocks any further growth in cabin equipment.
sections.description: The server and the separate network switch are replaced by a single second generation chassis in the same rack space. The rack partition D4420121334529 is retained, the upper partition D4420125490996 is replaced by a ventilated item and the stowage bin D4420129816843 is re-used. Anchor nuts EN258434K3 are renewed at every rack front attachment. The rack feeder is uprated by replacing the distribution tail with a larger conductor and moving the protection to a higher rating. The built-in test standard LD8CA72D35B supersedes the earlier boot software LC5R2884353 and parameter set LC4RABC2783. The forward seat display panel kit D4420116103848 is refitted unchanged.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Put the aircraft on ground power and isolate the cabin distribution. Get access to the equipment rack through the galley area and to the distribution panel. Disconnect and remove the existing server and, where fitted, the separate network switch. Remove the upper partition D4420125490996 and install the ventilated item. Replace the distribution tail with the larger conductor supplied in the kit, routing it on the existing supports, and install the higher rated protection device. Do an insulation resistance check on the new conductor before energising. Install the second generation chassis using the retained partition D4420121334529 and the stowage bin D4420129816843, on new anchor nuts EN258434K3. Reconnect and energise the cabin. Load the built-in test standard LD8CA72D35B and confirm the reported part number. Refit the forward seat display panel kit D4420116103848. Do a full cabin entertainment functional check with all seat groups powered, and record the measured feeder current at full load. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to TITAN-88 aircraft up to and including MSN T00217. Aircraft at the original server standard and aircraft at the interim standard are both covered by this Service Bulletin and use the same kit; the interim step is not a prerequisite. The feeder uprating is not optional and must be done in the same visit as the chassis change.
sections.material_note: Kit K4420-1042-01 contains the chassis, the ventilated partition, the feeder conductor, the protection device and the fastener set. Kit lead time is thirty-six weeks. Removed chassis and switches are returned to the supplier for credit.

type_data.compliance_time: At operator convenience, normally at a cabin refresh.
